name: Kana
source: A young Wolf Girl, and a member of a tribe that idolises breeding and judges beauty in those terms. Cast out for being 'ugly', Kana believes that she is worthless, that nobody will ever care for her. A chance meeting with the MC, however, relights a spark of hope…
